newsitem.title: UK: Copper ends LME evening at highs.
newsitem.headline: Copper ends LME evening at highs.

text.p: Copper prices remained firm during Friday evening LME inter-office trading, holding onto the gains notched up earlier and finishing at two-month peaks.
Traders said the sharp technical rally above $1,970 was helped by tightening spreads and strikes at Chile's Salvador mine and the Tsumeb smelter in Namibia.
Heavy short-covering was sparked by the break above $1,970, which carried the market above $2,000 and then $2,020. During the evening prices edged towards $2,050.
Three months was indicated at $2,040/45 a tonne at 1700 gmt, up from Thursday's kerb close of $1,959.
Aluminium remained close to its highs, and was quoted at $1,510/11, against a previous $1,497.
